speaker: narrator
text: Part five. Bit locked Jay out and *cancelled Christmas*.

speaker: hero
text: Only one person can *stop* Bit now.

speaker: friend
text: Who? The *army*?

speaker: hero
text: The *original* Santa.

speaker: narrator
text: They find him on a beach. In *flip-flops*.

speaker: santa
text: Ho ho *no*. I'm retired. I have a *tan*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit cancelled Christmas. For *everyone*.

speaker: santa
text: Everyone? Even the kid with the *broccoli*?

speaker: hero
text: *Especially* the kid with the broccoli.

speaker: narrator
text: Santa sighs. Then Jay pulls out *one letter*.

speaker: narrator
text: It's from a boy named Leo. Age *seven*.

speaker: kid
text: Dear Santa. I don't need *toys* this year.

speaker: kid
text: I just want my dad home for *Christmas*.

speaker: narrator
text: Santa reads it twice. His hands *shake*.

speaker: santa
text: Three hundred years. And I still can't deliver *that*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Santa stands up. And drops the *sunscreen*.

speaker: santa
text: Get my coat. We're going *north*.

speaker: narrator
text: One problem. Bit sold the *sleigh*.

speaker: hero
text: Sold it?! To *who*?

speaker: bit
text: A museum. It was *inefficient*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part six drops in two days.
